Thanks for the summary and the packet. A few quick notes from procurement: 

- We do prefer PO (Net 30) by default for vendor spend. Card is allowed for < $5k, otherwise it goes through PO.

Hi Lisa / Marissa -

Thanks for the quick reply, Lisa - looping in the specific details so procurement/AP has a single place to reference. Below is the standard Redwood vendor setup guidance and the typical routing depending on payment method: 

Vendor setup checklist (what procurement usually needs):
- Completed W-9 (received) OR W-8BEN (for non-US entity)
- Vendor setup packet (attached) - includes legal name, address, tax id, remittance address, primary contact
- Banking/ACH form (if customer wants to pay by ACH) - attached as banking_info_form.xlsx
- Contact for invoicing / AP email (you provided jessica.park@acme-analytics.com)

Payment paths and notes:
1) PO (preferred by Acme) - Redwood will issue invoices referencing the PO number you provide. Default payment terms we can accept are Net 30. If Acme needs Net 45 or other, we're open to review but will flag to finance. Timeline: once vendor is entered, first invoice typically processes on your next AP cycle (1-2 weeks depending on your vendor onboarding speed).

2) Card - supported for smaller purchases; we can accept card payment for trial/initial usage if you want to expedite access.

3) Marketplace (AWS Marketplace) - we do list on AWS Marketplace; that path delegates billing to the marketplace and may simplify some procurement requirements, but marketplace onboarding + customer procurement approval can add 2-4 weeks. If you'd like us to start Marketplace evaluation, we'll need authorization to proceed.

Doc/links: 
- Vendor packet attached: vendor_setup_packet.pdf (fillable)
- Banking form attached: banking_info_form.xlsx
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567 (for your reference)

Next steps I recommend:
- Marissa: please re-send vendor packet to procurement@acme-analytics.com with the attachments and request the PO number format for invoices.
- Lisa: if you can confirm PO cadence and expected date for vendor entry, we'll coordinate first invoice timing.
- If helpful, we can set a 15-20m handoff call between Jessica (AP) and me to answer any field-level questions in the packet.

Thanks - happy to jump on a quick call this week.
